newsitem.title: UK: UK shares dragged lower by ex-dividends at opening.
newsitem.headline: UK shares dragged lower by ex-dividends at opening.

text.p: UK shares were marked cautiously lower at the start of trading on Monday, depressed by a batch of stocks going ex-dividend and unsettled by continuing fears of a rise in interest rates.

The FTSE 100 index was down 2.3 points at 4,055.9 by 0836 GMT, though stocks going ex-dividend including Allied Domecq and National Power knocked some 3.1 points off the blue chip index. Decliners were in a four-to-three majority.
Traders said shares could find support from a firm Wall Street performance on Friday but was likely to be weighed down by continued sterling and worries over interest rates.
